**Main line:** Qe7+ Qxe7 Rxe7+ Kh8 Rxc3

**Coaching note:**

Black's queen was forced to defend against the check. Notice how Qe7+ forces the queen to capture (it's the only way to stop mate threats), pulling it away from defending the rook on c3. After the forced sequence, White wins the rook with Rxc3. When you see a forcing move that pulls a defender away from its duties, calculate whether you can exploit the now-undefended piece. This deflection pattern wins material decisively.
